'''Ultimate Power''' is the first of four releases of [[Virtual Block 7]], a legacy virtual expansion. Its text is official as of 18 June 2010.<ref name="pdf" /> The release has 48 cards: 30 Dark Side and 18 Light Side.

The cover includes a rules card. Missions deploy during the deploy phase like Effects. A player may have any number of Missions on table but only one Critical Mission. A player who plays an Objective may deploy only Missions with the icon shown on the rules card. The virtual Alter (Light and Dark) may be placed over either the Premiere or the Coruscant Alter.<ref name="pdf" />

== Discrepancies ==
* The release prints one virtual Alter per side, to be placed over either the Premiere or the Coruscant Alter.<ref name="pdf" /> The [[Virtual Block 7]] card list has separate Premiere and Coruscant versions; this list links the Premiere ones.
* Printed as Cyborg Commander, Hunter Of Jedi; later released as [[Grievous, Hunter Of Jedi]].<ref name="pdf" /><ref name="dl">[https://github.com/swccgpc/swccg-card-json/blob/d4e661ec735dcb111266fbda98704f2181e1cfab/DarkLegacy.json DarkLegacy.json] (swccg-card-json legacy card data). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261020183346/https://raw.githubusercontent.com/swccgpc/swccg-card-json/d4e661ec735dcb111266fbda98704f2181e1cfab/DarkLegacy.json Internet Archive].</ref>
* Printed as Ice-Heart; later released as [[Ysanne Isard (Dark)]].<ref name="pdf" /><ref name="dl" />
